whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Fitnation Gym,

I noticed your gym has strong 4.5★ reviews from 212+ members in Kadamkuan, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new membership and batch inquiries.

Maine aapke gym ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, morning/evening timings, aur workout program showcase integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/fitnation

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Fitnation Gym team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Fitnation Gym in Kadamkuan, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking, morning/evening batch timings, and your 4.5-star reputation right at the top. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact trainer details aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
